(Translated by Google) I stopped at this YPF station during my trip to Argentina and the service was always smooth and friendly. Depending on the time of day, there was a slightly longer line, but nothing that spoiled the experience. I always filled up with Infinia fuel and never had any problems with it.

Passei por este YPF durante minha viagem pela Argentina e o atendimento foi sempre tranquilo e cordial. Dependendo do horário, havia um pouco mais de fila, mas nada que prejudicasse a experiência. Sempre abasteci com Infinia e não tive qualquer problema com o combustível.
